newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's industrial activity climbs 8.6 pct in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's industrial activity climbs 8.6 pct in Jan.

text.p: Industrial activity rose 8.6 percent in January compared to the same month a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said Tuesday in a statement.
It was the 13th consecutive month of positive growth registered in the sector, the ministry said.
"This increase in industrial activity came from dynamism registered in industrial manufacturing, construction and the generation of electricity, gas and water," it said.

Industrial manufacturing jumped 9.4 percent in January versus January 1996, the ministry said. The in-bond maquiladora sub-sector rose 22.6 percent in the same time period and non-maquiladora sector moved up 8.5 percent.
Construction was up 8.4 percent in the same reference period, and the generation of electricity, gas and water rose 6.7 percent, it added.

Mining activity registered no change compared to the same month a year earlier. It was balanced out by an increase of 4.8 percent in the petroleum sub-sector and a reduction of 6.3 percent in traditional metals and mineral mining sub-sector.
